request.style: English, soft female solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, light percussion, hopeful and urgent mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When they heard his voice they were cut to the heart
Brothers what shall we do in this place
Peter answered clearly with a call to turn
Repent and be baptized in Christ's name

[Chorus]
In the name of Jesus Christ for forgiveness
Receive the gift of the Holy Spirit now
The promise is for you and your children
For all whom the Lord our God calls home

[Verse]
Be saved from this crooked generation
Many words he bore witness with
Those who welcomed the message that day
About three thousand souls were added

[Chorus]
In the name of Jesus Christ for forgiveness
Receive the gift of the Holy Spirit now
The promise is for you and your children
For all whom the Lord our God calls home

[Bridge]
Devoted to the apostles teaching
Fellowship and breaking of bread
Prayers and the faith they shared
Living in the light of grace

[Outro]
The promise is for you and your children
For all whom the Lord our God calls home
